continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked services Phase A: object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade, and state/invocation rejection on completed objects.

progress_update.summary: Implemented all of Phase A linked services on the linked-services branch. Four waves executed: storage foundation, command stacks (3 vertical slices), state machine handlers, and integration tests. Code review found and fixed 3 issues: cycle detection crash (LinkedFrom empty value deserialization), external state mutation bypass on completed objects, and onCompleted handler losing failure info. Refactored EdgeState → ServiceEdgeState with proto oneof unifying edge label and state into LinkedToActive/LinkedToCompleted/LinkedFrom variants. Removed docs/design/linked_services.md from git history (design docs not committed). 9 clean commits, 6/6 tests passing.
progress_update.goal: Implement linked services Phase A: object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade, and state/invocation rejection on completed objects.
accomplished: Implemented full Phase A: ServiceEdges table, ServiceNodeId, VirtualObjectStatus::Completed, LinkServiceCommand, CompleteServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceCommand — all with journal types, proto, codec, outbox messages, WAL dispatch, state machine handlers

6 integration tests: link establishment (happy + self-link rejection), object completion (happy + double rejection + state/invocation rejection), unlink + GC cascade with grandchild (happy + non-completed no-GC)
Fixed 3 code review findings: cycle detection crash (C1), external state mutation bypass (I1), onCompleted failure encoding (I2)
Refactored ServiceEdgeState to proto oneof with LinkedToActive/LinkedToCompleted/LinkedFrom — edge label derived from variant, no separate u8 param
Fixed LinkServiceResponse to carry remote_node_id for stale edge cleanup on error
progress_update.now: Phase A implementation complete. All code review findings addressed. 9 commits on linked-services branch, 6/6 tests passing. Design doc removed from git history.
next_steps: E2E testing requires SDK-side implementation (sdk-shared-core + Rust SDK) for LinkServiceCommandMessage, CompleteServiceCommandMessage, UnlinkServiceCommandMessage
Phase B: InvocationEdges table, StartLinkedCommand, workflow invocation linking — builds on Phase A
Consider squashing the 9 commits before PR
Run full test suite (cargo nextest run --all-features) to verify no regressions
constraints: ServiceNodeId (not NodeId) — NodeId already exists in restate_types for cluster nodes
ServiceEdgeState proto oneof: LinkedToActive/LinkedToCompleted/LinkedFrom — edge label derived from variant
Proto type IDs: LinkService=0x0415/0x8015, CompleteService=0x0416/0x8016, UnlinkService=0x0417
Completed objects reject new invocations at inbox AND state mutations from in-flight handlers
GC cascade: no LinkedFrom parents + Completed → delete state/promises/status/edges + propagate UnlinkServiceRequest
Direct cycle detection only via get_service_linked_from prefix scan
Design docs (docs/design/) NOT committed to this branch
All tables are logical (2-byte KeyKind prefix) within one RocksDB CF per partition
WAL serialization must remain backward compatible (Option<T> defaults to None)
ServiceCompletionNotification and InvocationResponse are orthogonal — graph management vs result delivery
decisions: ServiceEdgeState uses proto oneof to unify edge label + state — no separate edge_label param on put_service_edge
LinkedFrom edges store a minimal ServiceEdgeState::LinkedFrom proto value (not empty bytes) to prevent deserialization errors
onCompleted handler encodes failure details as JSON in argument bytes
LinkServiceResponse carries remote_node_id so on_link_service_response can clean up stale LinkedTo edge on error
Unlink (not RemoveLink) as the verb for edge removal — UnlinkServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceRequest, ctx.unlink()
VirtualObjectStatus: Unlocked | Locked(InvocationId) | Completed(ResponseResult) — mutually exclusive, Completed is terminal
Vertical command slices for linked-services implementation — each command task covers its full stack (journal + proto + codec + outbox + WAL)
GC cascade: no parents + Completed → delete state/promises/status/edges + propagate UnlinkServiceRequest to children
Phase A ships independently from Phase B (invocation linking) — Phase A anchors only objects, Phase B adds WorkflowInvocation nodes

Linking to already-completed child — should reject or immediately send ServiceCompletionNotification?
Batch GC optimization — batching UnlinkServiceRequest per destination partition
Whether append_invocation Appended→Submitted response type change is a breaking API change
Whether WAL format version bump needed for adding Option<PartitionProcessorRpcRequestId> to command payloads
No timeout on partition processor RPCs — pre-existing concern surfaced during analysis
risks: Adding request_id to NotifySignalRequest changes WAL serialization — needs careful backward compatibility testing
